title: Maritime Transport
description: Bulk maritime transport coordination supporting international commodity trade including grains, sugar, vegetable oils, and fertilizers through established shipping networks.
overview:
AFGT coordinates bulk maritime transport for agricultural and industrial commodities across major international shipping routes. Through established relationships with vessel operators, freight brokers, and logistics partners, the company supports shipment planning aligned with commodity specifications, cargo volumes, and destination ports.

Services include coordination of vessel chartering, freight negotiation, and shipment scheduling for bulk cargo movements across global trade corridors.

specifications.label: Cargo Types
specifications.value: Wheat, barley, sugar, vegetable oils, fertilizers, and bulk agricultural commodities

specifications.label: Services
specifications.value: Voyage charter coordination, time charter arrangements, freight negotiation, and cargo shipment management

specifications.label: Routes
specifications.value: Black Sea, Middle East, Mediterranean, Asia, and African trade corridors

origins: Global maritime shipping network with coordination across major commodity export corridors
certifications: International vessel vetting and maritime compliance procedures
Cargo insurance and freight documentation coordination
